==About==

{{i|Tomato}}es can be purchased from [[Stalls#Jordan Gramsey - Cooking Needs|Jordan Gramsey]] in [[Providence]] for 110x {{i|Silver Pieces}}, or, with the [[Vegetable Potting]] Skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Tomato}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When Picking your Tomatoes there is a chance to get {{i|Big Red}}s instead. Planting Vegetables in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Tomato can be stored in a {{i|Veggie Sack}}.
